methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Thermal efficiency is measured in MJ/kg clinker produced and has been a topic of continuous optimisation focus in PPC.

paper_type.evidence_quote: PPC is implementing a corporate energy management program that targets implementing operational efficiency, the development of alternative energy sources and long term energy cost stability as three focus elements.

level_3b.evidence_quote: In the South African cement industry, remammg competitive is predicated on managing energy use well.

stage1.notes: One PPC organisational case spanning multiple cement/lime sites; EnPIs are production-normalised intensity ratios.

multi_site.evidence_quote: PPC is developing energy management systems at two pilot sites, De Hoek Cement Factory and Lime Acres Lime Factory.

country_region.evidence_quote: PPC is the leading supplier of cement in Southern Africa, with eight manufacturing facilities and three milling depots in South Africa, Botswana and Zimbabwe.

sector_of_activity.evidence_quote: The specific electrical energy consumption of a cement and lime plant is directly related to the output, as the process uses large capacity electrical motors to drive the milling process and the kiln.

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: The kiln feed is first heated, then calcined and then processed into cement clinker at a material temperature of 1450°C in the cement kiln.

ems_standard.evidence_quote: PPC is implementing a corporate energy management program that targets operational efficiency, alternative energy and energy cost stability, partnering with the Industrial Energy Efficiency Project of UNIDO to implement an Energy Management System (EnMS) based on ISO 50001.
